customSections.content: The first printed student date did not apply to every grade. HSD assigned the opening dates by grade and placed Family Connections and Transitions before students began classes.

customSections.label: How to Read HSD's November and June Dates
customSections.content: HSD used several official labels rather than treating these periods as one generic break or one fixed end-of-year extension.

groups.label: November conference and Thanksgiving days
items: Students did not attend November 24–28. The dates covered staff development and conference preparation, Family Conference Connections, Thanksgiving, and a licensed non-contract day. Students returned Monday, December 1.

groups.label: Scheduled end of school
items: June 11 was an early-release last day for grades K–11. June 12 was the last day for licensed staff, not a student attendance day.

groups.label: Possible make-up days
items: June 15–16 were reserved as possible school days after an inclement-weather closure. The adopted calendar said graduation dates would not be affected.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Hillsboro School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–6, 7, and 9 started Wednesday, September 3, 2025. Kindergarten, grade 8, and grades 10–12 started Thursday, September 4.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days were on the HSD 2025–26 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: HSD listed 173 student days: 87 in the first semester and 86 in the second semester.

calendarFaqs.q: When were Hillsboro students off for Thanksgiving in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Students did not attend November 24–28 for staff development and conference preparation, Family Conference Connections, Thanksgiving, and a licensed non-contract day. Students returned Monday, December 1.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Hillsboro School District Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break and the continuation of the no-school period ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. Students returned Monday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Hillsboro School District Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran March 23–27, 2026. Students returned Monday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of Hillsboro School District in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day for grades K–11 was Thursday, June 11, 2026, with early release. June 15–16 were listed as possible inclement-weather make-up days.

sourceReviewSummary: Last checked August 9, 2026. We verified this archived school year against HSD's 2025–26 district calendar record adopted January 28, 2025.
sourceReviewDetails: The adopted calendar record lists 87 and 86 student days, for 173 total student days.
The opening sequence assigns September 3 to grades 1–6, 7, and 9, then September 4 to kindergarten, grade 8, and grades 10–12.
Quarter and semester endings remain student days; the following grade-preparation or workday is listed separately when students do not attend.
June 15–16 were possible make-up days, not automatic attendance days, and HSD stated that graduation dates would not be affected.
HSD's former 2025–26 Finalsite PDF URL currently returns the 2026–27 PDF. To avoid sending families to the wrong calendar, this page does not present that legacy URL as a 2025–26 download.
